newsitem.title: USA: Search for Arizona Air Force plane continues.
newsitem.headline: Search for Arizona Air Force plane continues.

text.p: The search for a missing Air Force A-10 twin engine jet aircraft extended into a fourth day on Sunday with no sign of the plane or its pilot, officials said.
The A-10 Thunderbolt with a range of 288 miles disappeared on Wednesday west of Phoenix, Arizona, during a routine training mission.
The search extended to the Telluride, Colorado area on Saturday. A spokesman at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Arizona said the extensive search continued in Arizona and Colorado.
While a base hot line received many phone calls, rescue workers were unable to find either a crash site or confirm that the pilot used a parachute to escape, the spokesman said.
The A-10 Thunderbolt, which has only a pilot, is designed to provide close air support of ground forces and is used against ground targets including tanks and other armoured vehicles.
